faq:
مواعيد الجيم إيه؟
كل يوم من 10 صباحًا لـ 12 منتصف الليل.

في حصة تجريبية؟
أيوه، حصة مجانية واحدة للأعضاء الجدد.

ينفع أجمّد اشتراكي؟
أيوه، كلمنا على واتساب.
fixText_en: Come with your friends or family and enjoy a special group price. Ask us for details.
bookText_en:
1. Choose your membership from the Memberships tile.
2. Transfer the subscription fee (Vodafone Cash / InstaPay).
3. Write your name and phone number (and your member ID if you are renewing) below.
4. Send us the transfer screenshot on WhatsApp.
5. We confirm your booking and your card is ready.
faq_en:
What are the working hours?
Every day from 10 AM to 12 AM.

Is there a free trial session?
Yes, one free session for new members.

Can I freeze my membership?
Yes, please contact us on WhatsApp.
